Sort by the difference descending with NULLs last, then take the top 10. No rounding.

queries:
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
           AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_spent,
       avg_remaining,
       avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event WHERE avg_remaining IS NOT NULL) AS difference
FROM per_event
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(avg_remaining, 0))
FROM (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
);
SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM (SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id)
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event;
SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event;
